ITEM 1 | Pale golden-tan pieces with browned, slightly crisp edges, seared surface, moist interior, two to three chunky pieces each about 4-5 cm across and 1.5-2 cm thick, sitting on the left-center of the plate | 110
ITEM 2 | Dark green loose leaves with ruffled, frilly edges and thin stems, scattered over and between the protein pieces, slightly wilted, matte with a light moisture sheen, covering roughly 25% of the plate | 25
ITEM 3 | Small bright yellow kernels scattered in small clusters, firm, glossy, a few scattered among leaves and near the left pieces, each about 0.5 cm | 8
ITEM 4 | Thin orange-red shreds and flecks, slightly glossy, scattered among the leaves and beneath the protein pieces, small amounts | 4
ITEM 5 | Glossy brown-amber sheen and thin film of dressing or oil pooling lightly on the plate and coating the pieces and leaves, not a distinct mass | 6
